author: bardic-inspiration
name: Blood of the Grove
summary: A potion that returns the lost to health and ends all ailments.
description: Sap tapped from an ancient tree on a single night each year. A single drop is enough to wet the lips of a dying man.

stats.effect: When you drink this potion, you regain 10d4 + 10 hit points, and it ends the {ref:condition/blinded}, {ref:condition/deafened}, {ref:condition/poisoned}, and {ref:condition/paralyzed} conditions affecting you.
